Package org.isotc211._2005.gmi

Class MIMetadataType

java.lang.Object
org.isotc211._2005.gco.AbstractObjectType
org.isotc211._2005.gmd.MDMetadataType
org.isotc211._2005.gmi.MIMetadataType
public class MIMetadataType extends MDMetadataType
Description: Root entity that defines information about imagery or gridded data - shortName: IMetadata

Java class for MI_Metadata_Type complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="MI_Metadata_Type">
   <complexContent>
     <extension base="{http://www.isotc211.org/2005/gmd}MD_Metadata_Type">
       <sequence>
         <element name="acquisitionInformation" type="{http://www.isotc211.org/2005/gmi}MI_AcquisitionInformation_PropertyType" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
     </extension>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

  • Method Details

    • getAcquisitionInformations

      public List<MIAcquisitionInformationPropertyType> getAcquisitionInformations()
      Gets the value of the acquisitionInformations property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the acquisitionInformations property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getAcquisitionInformations().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list MIAcquisitionInformationPropertyType
